description: The Agency for Statistics of Bosnia and Herzegovina published the final results of the 2013 Census of Population, Households and Dwellings as a 268-page bilingual PDF. After thirteen population tables, a section on dwellings and buildings gives residential buildings by the number of dwellings they contain (from one to 51 or more), the number and floor space of dwellings by occupancy status, and dwellings for permanent habitation by number of rooms and floor space. Table 14.1 counts 1,078,156 residential buildings in the country, 624,761 in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, 425,554 in Republika Srpska and 27,841 in Brčko District. The census was carried out from 1 to 15 October 2013 with 30 September as reference, and the household and dwelling questionnaire is annexed. Format and access: free PDF; the census website is a JavaScript application. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the tables are in a PDF, the lower-level breakdowns in the later sub-tables were not read, and there are no service or utility variables in these tables. Simulation uses: building counts by size class and dwelling floor space for exposure and seismic risk models. Related records: IPUMS International and the EU building stock observatory.
